name: techvortex-iiitg
description: TechVortex IIITG — Climate and Ocean Intelligence Platform

scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "HUB-UI,HUB-API,OG-UI,OG-API,WX-UI,WX-API,CHATBOT,IQ-UI" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold,green.dim,yellow.bold,yellow.dim,cyan.bold,white.bold" "cd frontend && npm start" "cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8001" "cd OceanGuard/frontend && npm run dev" "cd OceanGuard/backend && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --port 8002" "cd weather-module/frontend && npm run dev" "cd weather-module/backend && python -m uvicorn api.forecast_api:app --port 8000" "cd chatbot && python app.py" "cd \"learning hub/ocean-iq\" && npm run dev"
